records.source: Vincent isn't a good dancer.
records.translation: Hindi mahusay sumayaw si Vincent.

records.source: I'm bored...
records.translation: Naiinip ako...

records.source: Hi there, @. Taking a breather?#$e#To tell you the truth, I'd rather be fishing right now.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nagpapahinga ka?#$e#Sa totoo lang, mas gugustuhin kong nangingisda ngayon.

records.source: Shhh... I'm learning the secrets of the perfect roast.
records.translation: Shhh... Pinag-aaralan ko ang mga lihim ng perpektong pag-ihaw.

records.source: I eagerly anticipate my visit to Stardew Valley each year. There's a palpable charm in the air!
records.translation: Sabik kong hinihintay ang pagdalaw ko sa Stardew Valley bawat taon. Ramdam na ramdam ang halina sa hangin!

records.source: After the soup tasting, let's go hang out on the docks away from everyone.$0
records.translation: Pagkatapos tikman ang sabaw, tumambay tayo sa mga pantalan, malayo sa lahat.$0

records.source: I heard a rumor that the governor is considering buying a vacation home here.$0
records.translation: May narinig akong sabi-sabing pinag-iisipan ng Gobernador na bumili ng bahay-bakasyunan dito.$0

records.source: You better grab a plate before it's all gone!$1
records.translation: Kumuha ka na ng pagkain bago maubos ang lahat!$1

records.source: I'm tempted to run back home and grab my bikini.$0#$b#The water's at a perfect temperature... I dipped my little toe in!$1
records.translation: Natutukso akong tumakbo pauwi at kunin ang bikini ko.$0#$b#Perpekto ang temperatura ng tubig... Isinawsaw ko ang hinliliit ko sa paa!$1

records.source: It's cooler back here in the shade. I'll join you at the buffet soon, okay?$0
records.translation: Mas malamig dito sa lilim. Sasama ako sa iyo sa handaan maya-maya, ha?$0

records.source: *pant* It might be time to take a break soon.$0#$e#We should dance together later, okay?$1
records.translation: *hingal* Baka kailangan ko nang magpahinga.$0#$e#Dapat tayong magsayaw mamaya, ha?$1

records.source: This music is making my legs move on their own... just like aerobics class!$0
records.translation: Kusang gumagalaw ang mga binti ko dahil sa musikang ito... gaya sa klase ng aerobics!$0

records.source: Today... I eat as much as I want. I'll do extra push-ups tomorrow!$0
records.translation: Ngayon... kakain ako hangga't gusto ko. Magpu-push-up pa ako bukas!$0

records.source: That soup is smelling zesty...#$e#Did you add something good? I'm getting hungry!$1
records.translation: Maanghang at mabango ang sabaw na iyon...#$e#May masarap ka bang idinagdag? Nagugutom na ako!$1

records.source: Do you remember when you caught me in this spot on that rainy day?$0#$e#Even though this is my solo spot... I was really glad you came.$1
records.translation: Naaalala mo noong natagpuan mo ako sa lugar na ito sa maulang araw na iyon?$0#$e#Kahit ito ang lugar kong mapag-isa... talagang natuwa akong dumating ka.$1

records.source: I would suggest we make time for a little 'rendezvous' in my old cabin... but I'm afraid it's become rather... musty... in my absence.
records.translation: Iminumungkahi kong maglaan tayo ng oras para sa isang munting lihim na tagpo sa dati kong kubo... pero natatakot akong medyo... amoy-kulob na roon... habang wala ako.

records.source: Mmm... that roast smells good.$0
records.translation: Mmm... masarap ang amoy ng inihaw na iyon.$0

records.source: My dad's obsessed with the governor's visit. Everything has to be perfect!#$e#I think he's hoping to be mayor some day...$9
records.translation: Nahuhumaling ang tatay ko sa pagdalaw ng Gobernador. Kailangang perpekto ang lahat!#$e#Sa tingin ko, umaasa siyang maging alkalde balang araw...$9

records.source: Demetrius... It's because it's fun!%noturn$5
records.translation: Demetrius... Dahil masaya ito!%noturn$5

records.source: Why do humans enjoy dancing? Perhaps it is an instinctual mechanism, so that we will inadvertently convey our genetic quality to potential mates?%noturn
records.translation: Bakit nasisiyahang sumayaw ang mga tao? Likas kaya itong mekanismo upang hindi sinasadyang maipakita natin sa mga maaaring kapareha ang kalidad ng ating mga gene?%noturn

records.source: Ow... this bench has been cooking in the sun all day.$2
records.translation: Aray... Maghapong pinainit ng araw ang bangkong ito.$2

records.source: Oh, hey. Looking to escape the noise too?$0
records.translation: Ah, kumusta. Nagtatangkang tumakas din sa ingay?$0

records.source: Ah, can you smell that?$0#$b#It's a signal that the roast is almost ready!$1
records.translation: Ah, naaamoy mo ba iyon?$0#$b#Hudyat iyon na halos handa na ang inihaw!$1

records.source: The moment Lewis steps away from the governor... that's my moment to rub elbows...$0#$e#Ah, I didn't see you there.$4#$e#If you want to buy something, talk to me on the other side of the counter.$1
records.translation: Kapag lumayo si Lewis sa Gobernador... iyon ang pagkakataon kong makipagkilala nang malapitan...$0#$e#Ah, hindi kita napansin.$4#$e#Kung may gusto kang bilhin, kausapin mo ako sa kabilang panig ng puwesto.$1

records.source: Gus used my potatoes to make several dishes for the buffet.$0#$e#So, what kind of ingredient are you adding to the soup?$0
records.translation: Ginamit ni Gus ang mga patatas ko para gumawa ng ilang putahe para sa handaan.$0#$e#Kung gayon, anong uri ng sangkap ang idadagdag mo sa sabaw?$0

records.source: Do you think if I went in the water, other people would follow? I don't want to be a solo swimmer!$0
records.translation: Sa tingin mo, susunod ang iba kung lumangoy ako? Ayokong lumangoy nang mag-isa!$0

records.source: Leek and garlic mashed potatoes? Hehe... honey, I think I've died and gone to heaven!%noturn$1
records.translation: Dinurog na patatas na may sibuyas-pranses at bawang? Hehe... mahal, para akong namatay at napunta sa langit!%noturn$1

records.source: Now, don't overeat dear. I wouldn't want you getting a stomach ache.%noturn$0
records.translation: Huwag kang kumain nang sobra, mahal. Ayokong sumakit ang tiyan mo.%noturn$0

records.source: The governor is our distinguished guest today! I expect all of you to be on your best behavior.#$b#For those who brought something for the potluck, contribute your ingredients to the soup cauldron.
records.translation: Ang Gobernador ang marangal nating panauhin ngayon! Inaasahan kong magpapakabait kayong lahat.#$b#Sa mga nagdala para sa salu-salo, idagdag ninyo ang mga sangkap ninyo sa kaldero ng sabaw.

records.source: *munch* This festival always has the best food.
records.translation: *nguya* Laging may pinakamasarap na pagkain ang pistang ito.

records.source: Isn't it wonderful to see our community come together like this? I try my best to treasure these moments.$0
records.translation: Hindi ba kahanga-hangang makitang nagkakaisa nang ganito ang komunidad natin? Ginagawa ko ang lahat para pahalagahan ang mga sandaling ito.$0

records.source: *slurp* Oh, yeah! I'm gonna need more of this!$1
records.translation: *higop* Ah, oo! Kailangan ko pa nito!$1

records.source: *pant* It's all in the hips!$0#$e#I think I need to take a break soon. I'm getting sweaty!$0
records.translation: *hingal* Nasa balakang ang lahat!$0#$e#Kailangan ko nang magpahinga maya-maya. Pinagpapawisan na ako!$0

records.source: Don't block the sun! I'm in just the right spot to avoid getting any tan lines.$0
records.translation: Huwag mong harangan ang araw! Sakto ang puwesto ko para hindi magkaroon ng mga guhit sa balat mula sa pagkabilad.$0

records.source: I've heard the summer season gets very busy for farmers. Make sure you don't overwork yourself!$0
records.translation: Narinig kong napakaabala ng tag-init para sa mga magsasaka. Tiyaking hindi ka magpakapagod!$0

records.source: *sniff* ...smells are powerful for bringing back memories...$0#$e#That can be good or bad...
records.translation: *singhot* ...malakas pumukaw ng mga alaala ang mga amoy...$0#$e#Maaaring mabuti o masama iyon...

records.source: Hello.#$e#Soup? Dancing? No thank you. I'm perfectly content right here. Besides, someone needs to keep watch in case a monster appears...$0
records.translation: Kumusta.#$e#Sabaw? Sayaw? Salamat, pero ayoko. Lubos akong nasisiyahan dito mismo. Bukod pa riyan, kailangang may magbantay sakaling may lumitaw na halimaw...$0

records.source: Next year, I gotta remember to bring my electric guitar... Imagine a solo at this part of the song!$0
records.translation: Sa susunod na taon, kailangan kong tandaang dalhin ang de-kuryenteng gitara ko... Isipin mo ang isang solo sa bahaging ito ng awit!$0

records.source: I can't seem to decide what to eat! There's too many options to choose from.$0
records.translation: Hindi ako makapagpasya kung ano ang kakainin! Napakaraming pagpipilian.$0

records.source: I'll never turn down free food.
records.translation: Hindi ko kailanman tatanggihan ang libreng pagkain.

records.source: Hello, @! Did you bring an ingredient for the potluck? Just climb the stairs and toss it right in!$1
records.translation: Kumusta, @! May dala ka bang sangkap para sa salu-salo? Umakyat ka lang sa hagdan at ihulog iyon!$1

records.source: Ah, the Luau... all the hustle and bustle of town brought to my very doorstep!$0
records.translation: Ah, ang Luau... lahat ng kaabalahan at ingay ng bayan ay dinala sa mismong pintuan ko!$0
